title: Determination Basis of the Claims Office: Member Cost Share on a Ridgecrest Advantage Medical Claim Line
content:
Member cost share on an adjudicated line under a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan is taken from the plan allowed amount for the line's benefit category at the plan held, never from the amount the provider billed.

### Conditions of record

- The enrollment is in a status of coverage in force or coverage in its premium grace period on the date of service of the line. The enrollment record is the authority, tested before the line is adjudicated and matched on the enrollment reference.
- An authorisation reference issued before the date of service is on record for every line whose benefit category the plan held lists as needing prior authorisation. The claim line and the coverage request record are the authority, read together on the claim reference and the reference of that request.

### How the member's share is taken

Where the category's cost share is a copay the member owes the copay or the plan allowed amount, whichever is lower. Where it is a coinsurance the member owes that percentage of the plan allowed amount, rounded to the nearest cent. Any medical deductible the plan held carries is met first out of the plan allowed amount of in-network lines in the order they were processed, before any copay or coinsurance applies.

### Cost share and the maximum out-of-pocket

The words *Cost share stops at the tier's in-network maximum out-of-pocket* are no longer in force. The remainder of that clause stands: once the member's accumulated cost share for the contract year has reached the maximum out-of-pocket, every further covered in-network line is adjudicated at zero member liability, and a line that would cross it is charged only up to the distance remaining.

### Particular categories

- The emergency department copay is waived where the visit leads to an inpatient admission within one day, and the inpatient per-day copay applies instead.
- An out-of-network line on a plan whose coinsurance for covered out-of-network care is one hundred per cent is denied for want of coverage out of network, except for emergency, urgently needed and renal dialysis services, which are always covered at the in-network cost share.
- Where the member's Medicaid status gives them cost-share protection on a plan that carries it, the member owes nothing on the line and the cost share is billed to the state instead.
- A line rendered without the authorisation that its category needs is denied for want of prior authorisation, and the denial notice carries the member's appeal rights.

### What never reaches the accumulator

Amounts the member pays for services the plan does not cover at all never count toward the maximum out-of-pocket, and the member is told so when they ask why their accumulator has not moved.
